entities.name: Buse Ünal

entities.summary: Buse Ünal is a Turkish women's volleyball player. She is 1.86 m tall at 72 kg (159 lb) and plays in the setter position. Currently, she plays for Bahçelievler Belediyespor. She is a member of the Turkey women's national volleyball team.
